frame: glTF y-up: the truck stands on y = 0 with its up on +y, its front on +z and its left side on +x; origin midway between the axles

spin.note: wheel_*.rotation.x += distance_m / 0.424 (rolling radius 0.424 m; positive rolls forward)

steer.note: steer_*.rotation.y = angle; pivot is the vertical line through the wheel centre (the real kingpin axis is not published). Rear steer limits are not published either.

covers.note: aero covers: set visible = false to show the bare rims

lights.note: tail: the thin strip across the band and the red lamps under the tailgate, lit with the lights (their emission in the GLB). Braking (c080; The Drive, The Autopian): the middle of the strip goes out and the end caps fill solid red with a shorter bar under it in the middle. The turn signals are the end caps, red on US trucks. Reverse: white lamps either side of the plate. gate_* parts ride on the tailgate node

material: brushed stainless is metallic: the scene needs environment lighting

fl.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); before it swings, its frameless glass (door_*_glass) drops glassDropMm down its slant, and rises once the door is shut; btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

rl.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); before it swings, its frameless glass (door_*_glass) drops glassDropMm down its slant, and rises once the door is shut; btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

fr.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); before it swings, its frameless glass (door_*_glass) drops glassDropMm down its slant, and rises once the door is shut; btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

rr.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); before it swings, its frameless glass (door_*_glass) drops glassDropMm down its slant, and rises once the door is shut; btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

strutsNote: the tailgate struts, l and r: body is in the root node cybertruck's own frame, gate in the tailgate node's (both millimetres, glTF axes); draw each strut between the two
hingedNote: each node turns about its own axis (glTF frame) by openDeg to open: tailgate (drops to level with the bed floor; struts strut_body_<l|r> to strut_gate_<l|r>), bedlid (the under-bed compartment, lifts from its front edge), outlet_cover (the left wall: two 120 V and one 240 V outlets behind it)

tonneau.note: path is [z, y] in metres on the centreline, arc its length from the first point. Opening by u metres puts slat i at arc closedArc[i] + u, with x = 0 and its rotation about +x so its +z follows the path forward (rotation.x = atan2(-dy, dz)). travel opens it fully. The switch is on the left sail by the tail light: open, close, tailgate (front to back). bed_lights: the LED strips along the bed walls.

yoke.note: parts turn together about the column; the column stays. controls: press the centre pad for the horn (manual, Steering: "press and hold the center pad"); the left pod's keys are the turn signals (right above, left below) and the high beam, the right pod's top outer key the wiper (a quick press: one wipe), each its own mesh over its printed symbol. signals: the amber corner lamps (lower lamp strip ends) on each side, which blink with that turn signal

wiper.note: wiper_arm turns about axis (the windshield glass normal, glTF frame) through its pivot; parked it lies up the driver's A-pillar; one wipe turns it sweepDeg toward the passenger side, to horizontal along the cowl, and back (Owner's Manual, Windshield Wiper and Washers)

cabin: node "cabin": seats, dash, yoke, screens, trim (placed from the manual cabin sizes and video frames, not a replica); glass alpha from the factory light transmission: windshield 76%, front side 72%, rear side 23%, roof 3% (GLASS_VLT in assemble.py); the B-pillar glass is opaque
